tokens.name: mimosa
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. Glass cards sit on it.

tokens.name: sunny
tokens.usage: The one brand accent, used as a fill: primary buttons, progress fills, active nav, feature cards. Never text on mimosa at any size (about 1.8:1).

tokens.name: on-sunny
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sunny fills, such as primary button labels.

tokens.name: sunny-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for background shapes behind glass, selected rows and progress tracks. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: sunny-deep
tokens.usage: Links and small accent text on mimosa and surface-solid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on mimosa, glass and surface-solid.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and captions on mimosa, glass and surface-solid.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Solid panel for long reading: lesson text and the AI coach chat.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of glass cards and navigation, always with glass-blur behind it.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px highlight edge on glass cards. Decorative only; it does not mark a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls, and dividers that carry meaning, on mimosa and surface-solid.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed scores and upward trends, as text or icon on mimosa and surface-solid. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed scores, errors and downward trends, as text or icon on mimosa and surface-solid. Always paired with a word or icon.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One short word or phrase per screen, in caps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sumulat ng 10 hooks para sa isang client.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small italic labels under display words and stats.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Glass card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, the sidebar and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The only shadow: under glass cards.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur radius on glass cards and navigation.
